Patient Bot: Hello. I'm calling because I need to cancel an upcoming appointment.
PGAI Agent: Calling PivotPoint Orthopedics. Part of Pretty Good
Patient Bot: Hi. This is
PGAI Agent: Am I speaking with David?
Patient Bot: Hi. Um, no. This is Maria Rodriguez. I actually need to cancel an appointment I have coming up. You help me with that? Also, is there, like, a cancellation fee or policy I should know about?
PGAI Agent: Please provide the full name and date of birth of the patient I can look up the appointment.
Patient Bot: Sure. My full name is Maria Rodriguez, and my date of birth is July 22nd 19 90. Thank you.
PGAI Agent: Just to confirm, I have your name as Maria Rodriguez? And your date of birth as July 22nd
Patient Bot: Yes.
Patient Bot: Yes. That's right. Maria Rodriguez? July 22nd 19 90.
PGAI Agent: Would you like me to look up your record using the phone number you have on file with us?
Patient Bot: Thanks.
PGAI Agent: If so, please tell me that number. If you're not sure, just let me know.
Patient Bot: I'm not totally sure what number you have on file. Could you please check using my name and date of birth? That would be great. Thanks.
PGAI Agent: Did you place spell out your 1st and last name for me just to make sure I have it exactly right? And can you confirm your date of birth 1 more time?
Patient Bot: Sure. It's m a r a r I g u e z. And my date of birth is July 22nd. 19 90. Thanks for double checking.
PGAI Agent: Thanks for spelling that out. Just to confirm, is your 1st name Maria and your last name Rodriguez? With your date of birth as July 22nd 19 90?
Patient Bot: Yes. That's right. Maria Rodriguez July 22nd, 19 90. Thanks for confirming.
PGAI Agent: I have your phone number as 3 0 5 5 6 0 5 7 7 2 and your date of birth is July 22nd 19 90. Is that correct?
Patient Bot: Yes. That's correct. Thank you for check yes. That's my number. Thanks for confirming. So, um, can you please cancel my appointment? And, also,
PGAI Agent: I can't access the appointment details right now, but I'll make sure our clinic support team follows up with you. Please hold while I document your request. Connecting you to a representative. Please wait. Hello. You've reached the Pretty Good AI test line. Goodbye.
Patient Bot: Oh, okay. Thanks for your help anyway. Have a good day. Goodbye.
summary: Maria Rodriguez called to cancel an upcoming appointment and inquire about any associated cancellation fees. After a lengthy identity verification process, the agent was unable to directly access the appointment details or provide fee information. The agent stated that the clinic support team would follow up with Maria and then ended the call.
